title: Visit Banjarmasin
content_en:
Project Overview

Visit Banjarmasin is the premier digital tourism and cultural exploration portal for the iconic City of a Thousand Rivers. It offers visitors an immersive guide to river tourism, Banjar cultural heritage, culinary journeys, and Smart City public services.

The Challenge

Regional tourism information is often scattered across outdated websites, lacks interactive navigation for river routes, and fails to provide international-standard digital experiences for modern tourists.

The Solution

Engineered with Next.js, interactive mapping, and a responsive mobile-first architecture, Visit Banjarmasin aggregates verified historical narratives, floating market boat schedules, and culinary trails into an elegant, high-speed web portal.

Key Features

  • River Tourism Guide: Complete navigation for Lok Baintan and Siring floating markets with boat rental rates.
  • Cultural Heritage Showcase: Curated Banjar architectural history, traditional festivals, and historical mosques.
  • Culinary Discovery: Directory of legendary authentic cuisine (Soto Banjar, Ketupat Kandangan, Bingka).
  • Smart City Hub: Direct links to municipal public facilities, emergency helplines, and visitor information centers.

Ringkasan Proyek

Visit Banjarmasin adalah portal eksplorasi pariwisata dan kebudayaan resmi untuk Kota Seribu Sungai. Menghadirkan panduan komprehensif wisata susur sungai, warisan budaya Banjar, rute kuliner legendaris, dan integrasi inovasi Smart City.

Tantangan

Informasi pariwisata daerah sering kali tersebar di berbagai situs yang kurang terawat, tidak memiliki panduan rute sungai yang interaktif, dan belum menawarkan pengalaman digital standar modern bagi wisatawan.

Solusi Teknis

Dibangun dengan Next.js, pemetaan interaktif, dan arsitektur mobile-first yang responsif, Visit Banjarmasin menyatukan narasi sejarah terverifikasi, jadwal perahu pasar terapung, dan jalur kuliner khas ke dalam portal web berkecepatan tinggi.

Fitur Utama

  • Panduan Wisata Sungai: Informasi lengkap pasar terapung Lok Baintan dan Siring beserta tarif sewa kelotok.
  • Eksplorasi Budaya: Sejarah arsitektur Banjar, festival tradisional, dan masjid bersejarah Sultan Suriansyah.
  • Wisata Kuliner: Direktori kuliner autentik legendaris (Soto Banjar, Ketupat Kandangan, Lontong Orari).
  • Smart City Hub: Akses terpusat ke fasilitas publik, layanan darurat, dan pusat informasi wisatawan.
